subject: Banking
title: The Rise of Neobanks
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Rise of Neobanks.

hook.text: Revolut reached 40 million customers without a single physical branch. Everything happens through a smartphone app.

buildup.text: Neobanks emerged after 2010, offering sleek apps, zero fees, and instant notifications.

discovery.text: Without branch costs, neobanks operate at a fraction of traditional bank expenses. Revolut spends 80% less per customer.

twist.text: Most neobanks have never turned a profit. Chime, Monzo, and N26 all burned billions in venture capital chasing growth.

climax.text: Neobanks proved banking could be reimagined. Whether they can survive as businesses is still an open question.

punchline.text: 40 million customers, zero branches, zero profit. Growth is not survival.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge facing most neobanks?
options: Achieving profitability despite rapid customer growth
